known_release_blockers: The single benchmark binary currently has only the tactile profile; physics throughput, rollout latency, memory, randomized stress, and long-soak profiles remain incomplete.
No general MJCF importer is present.
TaskIR still lacks frame acceleration, full Jacobian tensor publication, generic gates and reductions, and three qualified task families.
Presentation and tactile execution have not been folded into the common SensorIR schedule; recorder routing, ray, and LiDAR operators remain incomplete.
PolicyIR has no convolutional, residual, normalization, recurrent, or attention operators.
No production native adjoint or discontinuity-validity API exists.
The G1 policy is not standing or walking qualification evidence.
The ten-million-transition release soak has not run.
